claims.register_section: Stage 4. Choi 2020, roadmap paper 2, re-entered at the owner's direction (2026-09-15)

claims.status: Not established as a meaningful figure

claims.register_section: Stage 4. Choi 2020, roadmap paper 2, re-entered at the owner's direction (2026-09-15)

claims.register_section: Stage 4. Choi 2020, roadmap paper 2, re-entered at the owner's direction (2026-09-15)

claims.design_and_observation: trial W1 under CAMERA on the same design: no set at FDR < 0.05 in either contrast (0.95 in late active repair against resolution, 0.46 to 0.48 in resolution against long-term); the proliferation sets carry an inter-gene correlation of 0.30 to 0.45 across animals, and the two hallmark sets a variance inflation of 55 to 69, so a hallmark set of about 190 genes carries the independent information of about three; the ornithine set had 7 genes and was not tested Official reference limma CAMERA reproduces the no-hit result under both historical logCPM and voom/TMM transformations with estimated correlation.
claims.limitations_and_interpretation: Moderate, for the method more than the biology: an absence at these arms bounds nothing (rule R9), but the correlation it measured is the reason a gene-permutation null, as used for C158 and discovery in C161, can report FDR 0.000 for a proliferation set. Whether C158 survives a correlation-respecting test on its own myeloid pseudobulk is untested The original custom statistic is retained as historical. The undersized seven-gene ornithine set was not tested, and failed significance is not equivalence or absence of a circuit.
claims.sample_definition: W1 frozen sets and reference-method correction; undersized ornithine set not tested
